programs.title: The Zoo
programs.desc: Keepers introduce three gaur, a large species of cattle, to the rest of the herd  a sickly sambar fawn is rushed to the health center  the bird department prepares for the arrival of great hornbills.

programs.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet: Rise to the Challenge
programs.desc: Dr. Jeff attempts to diagnose a dog's devastating mystery illness  vet tech Hector's daughter is tasked with caring for a mother dog and her seven pups  Dr. Baier volunteers to help find new homes for rescued rabbits.

programs.title: I Was Prey: Night Stalker
programs.desc: A black bear charges Joe Azzouggagh and his German shepherd, Ace, deep in the Ontario wilderness  single father Andrew Dickehage, forced to walk six miles along a rural road at night, comes under attack from unseen predators.

programs.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Road Trip Rescue
programs.desc: Carrying three baby kangaroos and an emu, the Irwins caravan into the Australian Outback to release the animals on Mourachan, their giant wildlife conservation property  plans shift when they discover more animals in need of rescue along the way.

programs.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Out on a Limb
programs.desc: Tom must navigate a sloping tree to rescue a difficult cat  Shaun faces wet and damp conditions to save a friendly, homesick stray.

programs.title: Wild Flix
programs.desc: Wild Flix broadcasts wildlife documentaries, zoo life insights, and animal rescue stories in Hindi, curated by Warner Bros. Television.
